zh.name: VIVIAN WANG
zh.role: 化妆总监 | VIVIAN ADVENTURE 创始人
zh.bio:
资深影视与时尚，专注中英及国际项目：
• 英国电影电视剧造型总监
• 加拿大电影服化道总执行
• 尚美巴黎（Chaumet）高珠晚宴、时装周秀场及明星红毯特邀合作造型总监
• 服务领域：电影制作、短剧、综艺、广告、时尚、婚礼定制、高端定制、明星同款旅拍

en.name: Vivian Wang
en.role: Makeup Director | Founder of VIVIAN ADVENTURE
en.bio:
Experienced in film & fashion across UK–China projects:
• Styling Director (UK film & TV)
• Executive Head of Costume & Makeup (Canadian films)
• Invited lead for Chaumet high jewelry gala & fashion weeks
• Services: film, short dramas, variety, commercials, fashion, wedding couture, bespoke travel shoots

zh.name: Hao
zh.bio:
专注时尚与艺人肖像光影塑造，注重层次与质感的稳定输出。
流程：前期面部/材质观察 → 光比规划 → 现场微调与回看。
风格：稳健光比、克制修饰、定制化方案。

en.name: Hao
en.bio:
Fashion & artist portrait light shaping with consistent tonal depth.
Workflow: facial/material scan → ratio plan → live micro‑adjust & review.
Style: controlled ratios, restrained retouch, tailored planning.

zh.name: Jade
zh.bio:
电影与时尚影像创作，擅长情绪光影与人物表达。
特点：叙事张力、镜头节奏感、技术与美学平衡。

en.name: Jade
en.bio:
Film & fashion visual creator; strong at mood lighting and character expression.
Traits: narrative tension, rhythmic framing, craft–aesthetic balance.

zh.name: Patrick Xue
zh.role: 摄影师｜影像艺术创作者
zh.bio:
结合传统与实验媒介，探索材质与情绪的影像表达。
擅长：胶片/即时成像、叙事型 MV、材质肌理营造。

en.name: Patrick Xue
en.bio:
Blends traditional & experimental media to explore texture and mood.
Strengths: film & instant formats, narrative MV, material tactility.

zh.name: Kris
zh.bio:
以富士色彩与自然光构建呼吸感人像氛围。
擅长：自然街拍、克制细节、色温渐变。

en.name: Kris
en.bio:
Uses Fujifilm color & natural light for airy, restrained portraits.
Strengths: candid urban sessions, subtle detail, gentle temperature shifts.

zh.name: Fu
zh.bio:
专注色彩与情绪的平衡，塑造带时间质感的光影。
特点：留白控制、光影层次、真实情绪捕捉。

en.name: Fu
en.bio:
Balances color & emotion, shaping time‑layered light.
Traits: managed negative space, layered illumination, authentic mood capture.

zh.name: Lori
zh.role: 化妆师｜造型与发型设计
zh.bio:
重视妆发结构统一：试妆阶段先确立发根蓬松与轮廓，再匹配底妆质地。
常用：轻质分层底妆、低温卷塑形、点状高光强调骨骼。
协作：与摄影沟通光位反射，减少后期去油与过度修片。

en.name: Lori
en.bio:
Aligns hair structure & base finish early in trials for cohesive silhouettes.
Toolkit: lightweight layered base, low‑heat shaping, selective highlight points.
Collab: works with photographer on specular control to limit heavy retouch.

zh.name: Johnny
zh.bio:
根据骨骼与发旋规划侧区层次，快速湿发→干发造型切换适应多场景。
常用：自然雾面定型、低饱和肤色修饰、胡须与眉形精细边缘处理。
现场：支持 10 分钟快速重整，保持职业感。

en.name: Johnny
en.bio:
Plans side panel layering around structure & cowlicks; fast wet‑to‑dry restyles for multi‑scene shoots.
Toolkit: natural matte finishing, restrained tone correction, precise beard/brow edge clean‑up.
On‑site: offers 10‑minute refresh cycles for sustained polish.

zh.name: Ivy
zh.role: 摄影与妆造助理｜客户与档期协调
zh.bio:
前期执行档期冲突排查与物料清单，现场跟进镜头顺序与补光设备交接。
支持：基础补妆、耗材补充、拍摄节奏提醒。
管理：建立客户反馈与需求记录，便于二次优化。

en.name: Ivy
en.role: Photo & Styling Assistant | Client & Scheduling Coordinator
en.bio:
Prepares conflict checks & asset lists; tracks shot order & lighting hand‑offs.
Support: light touch‑ups, consumable replenishment, pacing reminders.
Ops: maintains client feedback log for iterative adjustments.
